title.rendered: MudPuddles Shop for Our School Week, 11/18 – 11/24

content.rendered: Mention Archer Glen when you shop at MudPuddles the week of 11/18 to 11/24 and 20% of your purchases will go back to the school. Need uninterrupted time to shop? We have you covered! Mrs. Woofter will be holding story time on Tuesday, 11/19 at 6:15pm. Drop your kids off in the book corner and enjoy some solo shopping time. Hope to see you there!
